tasks.label: Build Release (Local)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && conan create . --build=missing -s build_type=Release

tasks.label: Build Debug (Local)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && conan create . --build=missing -s build_type=Debug

tasks.label: Build Release (Docker)
args: source project-config.sh && docker build -t conan-builder . && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace -e PROJECT_NAME=$PROJECT_NAME -e PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR=$PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR -e PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR=$PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR -e PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH=$PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH conan-builder bash -c "cd /workspace && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build ."

tasks.label: Run Release (Local)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && rm -rf build/Release/CMakeCache.txt build/Release/CMakeFiles && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build . && ./build/Release/bin/$TARGET_NAME ${input:runArgs}

tasks.label: Run Release (Docker)
args: rm -rf build/Release/CMakeCache.txt build/Release/CMakeFiles && source project-config.sh && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace -e PROJECT_NAME=$PROJECT_NAME -e PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR=$PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR -e PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR=$PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR -e PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH=$PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH conan-builder bash -c "cd /workspace && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Release && conan build . && ./build/Release/bin/$TARGET_NAME ${input:runArgs}"

tasks.label: Launch (GDB Local Debug)
args: source .venv/bin/activate && source project-config.sh && rm -rf build/Debug/CMakeCache.txt build/Debug/CMakeFiles && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Debug && conan build . && gdb ./build/Debug/bin/$TARGET_NAME

tasks.label: Launch (GDB Docker Debug)
args: source project-config.sh && docker build -t conan-builder . && docker run -it --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace -e PROJECT_NAME=$PROJECT_NAME -e PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR=$PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR -e PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR=$PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR -e PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH=$PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH conan-builder bash -c "cd /workspace && conan install . --build=missing -s build_type=Debug && conan build . && gdb ./build/Debug/bin/$TARGET_NAME"
